content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a violation of the C programming language's variable declaration rules. The declarations of the variable `shProg` were placed after the usage of the variable within the function code blocks, leading to multiple compilation errors in MSVC (Microsoft Visual C++) regarding undeclared identifiers and syntax errors. The patch successfully resolves the issue by moving the declarations of `shProg` to the beginning of the relevant function blocks before any usage, ensuring that the compiler recognizes the variable prior to its usage.
